dedupe_keys.name: gate institute city digital twin pilot for sofia lozenets district 3d city model and use cases

description: The GATE Institute at Sofia University runs a City Digital Twin pilot that aims to show a digital twin can scale to real problems in designing and experimenting with the urban environment of Sofia. The site sets out six strands: a high-quality 3D city model starting with part of the city, semantic enrichment with data from many sources, spatial and temporal analysis of urban processes, sub-city fluid dynamics models to assess development scenarios, 3D visualisation and promotion of twins in city services. The first step was a 3D model of the Lozenets district covering the CityGML 2.0 building and relief modules, hosted on Cesium ion and shown in CesiumJS and Terria. A later study built an air quality twin that uses a fine-tuned LLAMA 3.1 70B model over more than one billion Sensor.Community records. Coverage: Sofia, starting with Lozenets. Access: public viewers and descriptions on the project site. Licence: not stated. Caveats: a research pilot, and the site does not say whether the model data can be downloaded. Simulation uses are wind and pollution scenarios for new development, and a base for building and public space digital twins in Sofia. Related records: the Sofia Lozenets rooftop imagery classification dataset, Cesium and CityGML.
